meta_title: Sell VPN From Your Own Store With VpnHood! PARTNER | VpnHood!
meta_description: Install VpnHood! PARTNER in your WHMCS and sell VPN access codes at your own prices. Orders, renewals and cancellations are handled automatically from your prepaid credit.
page_desc: A module for your WHMCS. Your customer buys on your site, your store gets the access code from us and hands it over in your own client area, and you never touch any of it.
hero_alt: A storefront with its door lit, handing out a glowing key
diagram_desc: Your customer buys from your store; your store orders an access code from the VpnHood! STORE, paid from your prepaid credit; the code comes back to your store, which shows it to your customer.
diagram_caption: your brand on every step the customer sees
need_desc: Three things. None of them is technical, and two of them come from us.
need_whmcs_desc: The store you already run, or one you set up for this. VpnHood! PARTNER installs into it like any other module.
need_account_desc: We open it and send you the sign-in details. That is the only thing you type in.
need_credit_desc: Every code your store sells is paid from it. Keep it topped up and orders never stall.
install_title: Install it and let it run
install_s1_desc: Download the module and extract it into the root of your WHMCS. It is free and open source, and it adds nothing you have to maintain.
install_s2_desc: Enter the details from your welcome email. The module connects to the VpnHood! STORE on its own and shows your balance and the plans you can sell.
install_s3_desc: Your plans are created for you, hidden and priced at zero, because only you decide your retail price. Set it, unhide them, and you are selling.
life_desc: Your store stays the system of record. Each of these events reaches us on its own, so the code a customer holds always matches the service they pay for.
life_order_desc: An access code is issued and appears in your customer's client area.
life_renew_desc: The code's expiry moves with the invoice you were paid for.
life_suspend_desc: An unpaid or suspended service suspends the code; reinstating it brings it back.
life_terminate_desc: The code expires. You stop paying for what you no longer sell.
next_title: In-app purchases need your own app
next_desc: VpnHood! PARTNER sells through your website. To sell inside an app as well, on Google Play or the App Store, the app has to be yours: that is the white-label route, and it starts from exactly what you set up here.
cta: Tell us what you sell and we will open a partner account.
